what: The declared corpus-breadth search-free instrument: the boundary-mark re-instrument's same six relabeling-invariant summaries over the same mark-excluded state space (1296 ordered types, the boundary mark's row and column excluded on both sides exactly as declared there), recomputed against a band population widened across the declared corpus breadth (twelve english and eleven latin members per cell, the standing roster replayed byte-identically and extended by the declared breadth members frozen under the standing corpus rules), priced under the same declared strict-all verdict rule with no assignment search anywhere in the instrument. The declared truthful question: with the band population widened across the corpus breadth under the declared draw rules, does the real's mark-excluded profile sit inside the extended band's range on every declared invariant in every (file, language) cell, or is at least one invariant outside - the measured test of whether the interior's separation holds as the roster grows. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, the mark located in each matrix's own alphabet (symbol 36 in every simulated encoding and the real file's own last mapped position), the full width's total recorded beside every block profile, and no boundary-adjusted marginal appears anywhere; the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side while the simulated alphabets are saturated at 36 in every cell)
declared.corpus_breadth_rule: the band population widens across the declared corpus breadth: five declared english slots (an early modern scriptural register, an eighteenth century satirical prose register, a verse register, a civic polemical register and a scientific non-fiction register) and three declared latin slots (classical epic verse, classical prose history and classical oratory), each filled by the declared roster's accepted candidates: ebook 10 the King James Version of the Bible, ebook 829 Gulliver's Travels (Swift), ebook 1041 Shakespeare's Sonnets, ebook 1404 The Federalist Papers, ebook 1228 On the Origin of Species (Darwin); ebook 227 Aeneidos (Virgil), ebook 18837 Commentarii de Bello Gallico, libri V-VIII (Caesar), ebook 226 Cicero's Orations; the standing roster replays first, the breadth members take the listed positions english 7 to 11 and latin 8 to 10, the declared homo_cross_enc kind's position axis extends, no new seed kind; each breadth member's processed stream must reach the standing roster's smallest member stream length (45,491 tokens, Vulgata Esther) and every accepted candidate clears that floor
declared.corpus_source_rule: the corpus discipline stands: each candidate fetched from the standing members' plain text source at the declared cache form, each accepted file stored raw with its Gutenberg markers and processed by the standing declared processing with no new step, a sha256 recorded for every accepted file, candidates probed in their marker spans before acceptance (the english common-word probe over the body in deciles with their head-and-trailing structure read, the processed stream through the declared loader, and mid-span samples read); the standing fetch verification was rehearsed: the cache serves the standing english2 marker span byte-identical (447,911 bytes, span sha256 7f95a6c0484513216cffa7d9e1e0314896faa21cb5a713d65c125a86f1f43695) at the same byte counts, with a two-line title capitalization drift upstream in the header metadata (the modern prometheus to The modern Prometheus, bytes 49, 60, 555 and 566), recorded as metadata drift the marker span does not carry; the rejected candidates and their causes are recorded verbatim in rejected_breadth_candidates; two further english candidates probed clean and not selected by the roster's declared five-slot design (ebook 3207 Leviathan, ebook 148 The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin); the acceptance bar is the standing scale in every respect: no english translation, gloss or apparatus interleaved through the body, and the english scaffolding totals inside the standing transcriber-note scale's 0 to 52 common-word hits

invariants.sorted_symbol_marginals: the 36 mark-excluded glyph marginals as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position over 36 positions
invariants.sorted_pair_multiset: the 1296 mark-excluded pair counts as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position
invariants.empty_type_count: the number of the block's mark-excluded pair types with zero counted occurrences, a scalar inside [min, max]
invariants.self_pair_share: the block's diagonal sum over the profile's glyph-pair total
invariants.top_k_shares: the share of the glyph-pair total carried by the k largest pair counts, at k 1, 10 and 50
invariants.pair_entropy: the natural entropy of the mark-excluded pair distribution in nats per counted glyph pair

declared.state_note: every profile here is the mark-excluded block of the same pair-count matrices the boundary-mark instrument priced: the real's kept-adjacent pairs and the encodings' full streams keep their structural difference, every share-valued invariant normalises by its own glyph-pair total, and the empty type count is a raw count tied to its own total and recorded in that context; the plaintext control's state is the 27 reference letters alone (729 types, no boundary mark) and takes no part in any envelope; the latin envelopes are size-mixed by the roster's own declared construction (the roster's member streams run 45,491 tokens upward), and the breadth members' declared draw-0 sources sit beside the standing members' frozen selected draws by declaration
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags; the standing budgets are not applicable and no machinery recording appears for that reason
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its stream after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.seed_kinds: the standing encoding and floor kinds replay at their frozen positions exactly as every predecessor declared, and the homo_cross_enc kind's position axis extends to the breadth members' listed positions (english 7 to 11, latin 8 to 10); no new seed kind is consumed
declared.seed_sharing: the standing members' encodings are byte-identical replays of their declared frozen draws with the selected draw read from the frozen restart artifact rather than re-derived; the breadth members' encodings take the stream's first draw at their listed positions, declared in advance with no selection performed; every block profile of every row is verified by the gate as the declared block of its own replayed encoding
declared.band_record_rule: the simulated band per language cell is the standing widened roster's selected-draw encodings (7 english and 8 latin members) plus the declared breadth members' draw-0 encodings (5 english and 3 latin), so 12 english and 11 latin member profiles per cell: each standing member's row carries its frozen selected_draw_index and the breadth rows carry the declared draw-0 marker, membership unconditional exactly as declared before
declared.plants_rule: the 30 plant encodings (5 per cell, the standing first references at the standing kinds) recorded as the instrument's own simulated calibration set, each reduced to its glyph block with the full width's total beside it, each cell recording its standing source's truncated length and the plants_at_source_identity boolean; no parity rule applies because there is no anchor geometry to exceed
declared.floors_rule: the 30 destroyed-adjacency floors recorded with their glyph-block profiles and their full-width totals; their declared role is the shuffled-structure control recorded beside the verdict, not part of any envelope
declared.plaintext_rule: each cell records the truncated standing reference's own plaintext stream profile computed by the same formulas on its own 27-type state (729 types), as the prose control beside the verdict; the state carries no boundary mark and takes no part in any envelope
declared.verdict_rule: declared strict-all: a cell is shape-consistent-with-homophonic-encoding only when every declared invariant of the real's glyph-block profile sits inside the closed range of that cell's widened band's glyph-block profiles (the two vector summaries term by term inside the band's per-position envelope over 36 sorted positions, the scalar summaries inside [min, max] at the stored 6-decimal rounding); any outside invariant makes the cell shape-outside-analogues, and every outside entry is recorded with its band range so the miss is audited not summarized
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is inside or outside per invariant, and the recorded distances are the outside entries' band ranges themselves
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.bridge_gate: before any profile is priced, every fact this instrument re-derives fresh that a frozen predecessor already recorded must equal that stored value field for field: the boundary-mark instrument's 288 anchor fields exactly as that instrument declared them (the restart-budget artifact's 171 anchors and the frozen search-free artifact's 117 full-width totals), then per cell the standing rows' mark-excluded profiles verified as replay-equal against the frozen boundary-mark artifact's stored rows: each standing member's file, ebook, plant_length, selected_draw_index, full-width total and block profile, each plant's block profile, each floor's block profile and each plaintext control's profile, 111 profile checks total (18 per english cell and 19 per latin cell times 3 files); the breadth members carry no frozen counterpart, their encodings take the declared draw-0 rule and their facts ride on the declared roster with sha256 records; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
